ruleDefinitions.name: Code Executed Via Office Add-in XLL File
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may abuse Microsoft Office add-ins to obtain persistence on a compromised system.
Office add-ins can be used to add functionality to Office programs
 Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*new\\-object\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ComObject\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.application.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\\.RegisterXLL.*"))
